info.title: Porch RPC Profile
info.description: A PROFILE (strict subset) of the Ethereum JSON-RPC API as defined by ethereum/execution-apis. Porch serves only the methods listed here — FREE in V0-V2; the `paid` tier only takes effect in V3. Per-method caps are in `x-porch`. Method params/results are NOT redefined here: the canonical schema for each method is the one in execution-apis. Verify a Porch node against the allowlisted methods for free with hive's `rpc-compat` suite.
info.x-porch-note: This file is normative for WHICH methods Porch serves and their caps. It is NOT normative for method shapes — execution-apis is.

x-porch-tiers.probe: Served free, unauthenticated, IP/connection rate-limited (DoS floor, spec §7/#23).
x-porch-tiers.paid: The eventual metered set. Served FREE in V0-V2; only in V3 does it require a valid payment ticket (a free node may still serve without one).

x-porch-excluded.eth_getLogs: Unbounded cost with wide ranges — excluded until per-method pricing exists (V3).

x-porch-reserved.eth_getProof: Reserved for the Correctness layer (V1): the node returns a Merkle proof the wallet verifies against a header from its own light client. Schema: execution-apis eth_getProof.
